info.title: Provision OCR
info.description: C++ OCR / document recognition service. Bit-for-bit compatible with the original Python aiohttp service.

post.description: Returns 200 when the server is up. When the service middleware is disabled, responds 503.

get.description: Read-only state of the local license subsystem. Excluded from the license gate so dashboards can poll even on a broken / expired license. Does NOT include machine-identifying or signing-key material. Specific deny reasons (fingerprint mismatch, request-limit reached, tampered counter, etc.) surface in the per-request 403 body, not here.

post.description: Submits an activation code to the License Server, persists the returned signed `.lic` and re-initialises the license subsystem — no restart needed. Idempotent for the same machine + code (the server returns the cached `.lic` without consuming a new slot). Excluded from the license gate so a locked (unlicensed / expired) server can still be activated. Restricted by the admin allowlist — callers not matching `reload_allow` receive 403. The License Server round-trip may take up to 15 s and only one activation runs at a time: a second call while one is in progress receives 409.

activationCode.description: Activation code issued for this license

403.description: Caller IP is not in the reload_allow list

409.description: Another activation is already in progress on this server — retry after it finishes

501.description: License subsystem disabled at compile time (PROVISION_NO_LICENSE build)

502.description: Activation failed — wrong / revoked code, no free slot, or License Server unreachable; `detail` carries the reason

post.summary: Reload model weights and template configs
post.description: Re-reads provision_ocr.ini (the `[weights]` per-model path overrides and text_*_img_w input widths), drops all loaded TorchScript sessions (Mask R-CNN, CRAFT, TextRecognizer, CharRecognizer, EfficientNet, Edge) and re-reads the per-template JSON configs. Sessions are lazily re-instantiated on the next request with the refreshed paths, so the weights_run sidecar can switch models without a process restart. The ini is parsed and validated as a whole BEFORE anything is applied: a value that does not parse answers 400 naming the key and leaves the running configuration untouched. The reload waits for in-flight inference jobs to drain, so the response can take a few seconds; only one reload runs at a time (409 otherwise). Restricted by the admin allowlist — callers not matching `reload_allow` receive 403.

200.description: Reload done — sessions dropped, models are re-created on the next request. `config_reloaded` is false when the process was started without a config directory (tests / embedders).

400.description: provision_ocr.ini did not validate — a numeric value does not parse; `message` names the key, the value and the file:line. The running configuration is unchanged.

403.description: Caller IP is not in the reload_allow list

409.description: A reload is already in progress — retry after it finishes

500.description: Reload failed after validation (weights directory unreadable, model sessions could not be dropped); `message` carries the reason, the server log the exception type.

post.summary: Recognize a document with the given template
post.description: Accepts a raw image body (JPEG/PNG/BMP/TIFF/WebP/GIF), a PDF, or a multipart upload (`file` or `body` field). PDFs are split into pages and processed page-by-page; multi-page output is merged into a single `pages` array. For PDFs an optional pagesFrom/pagesTo range limits processing to a page window; the response then carries pagesFrom/pagesTo/maxPages document-level metadata.

Same handler and accepted media types as POST /processing/{template}. Kept for backwards compatibility with legacy clients that used the `/processing2` path. For PDFs an optional pagesFrom/pagesTo range limits processing to a page window; the response then carries pagesFrom/pagesTo/maxPages document-level metadata.

LanguageParam.name: language
LanguageParam.description: Recognizer selection, comma-separated array (the parameter may also repeat). Default (no parameter, or [rus,eng]) — printed text, every character of both scripts (Cyrillic and Latin) with the automatic script router, no filter. [rus] — everything with the Russian recognizer. [eng] — everything with the Latin recognizer, the output limited to digits, punctuation, symbols and ASCII letters: a letter outside that set is not transliterated but replaced by the most probable allowed one (café → cafe). [rus,eng] — the same as the default: both scripts, no filter. [literal_rus] — HANDWRITTEN Russian (mask-based word detection + handwriting CRNN; table extraction disabled); any combination with literal_rus currently also runs the handwritten-Russian path. Unknown values → 400.

PagesFrom.name: pagesFrom
PagesFrom.description: PDF only: first page to process, 0-based inclusive. Ignored for images.

PagesTo.name: pagesTo
PagesTo.description: PDF only: end of the page range, EXCLUSIVE (pagesFrom=0&pagesTo=3 = first three pages). Default: through the last page. Must be >= pagesFrom (else 400). A range outside the document yields a valid response with zero pages. The PDF response document echoes pagesFrom/pagesTo and reports the real page count in maxPages; page_number values are the ORIGINAL document positions (1-based), not renumbered.

ImageOrMultipart.description: Image or PDF as raw body, or a multipart form with `file` / `body` part.

BadRequest.description: Bad input: file field missing, unknown template, invalid `language` / `pagesFrom` / `pagesTo`, unreadable or encrypted PDF. `message` says which; for a PDF it is prefixed `page N:` when the error came from a page (every selected page failed the same way). A page window outside the document is not an error: 200 with an empty `pages` and the real `maxPages`.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Image payload could not be decoded

InternalError.description: Server-side failure while processing — a model that is not loaded (missing weights after a reload, input width mismatch), a CUDA error, a template config that does not parse. `message` carries the reason (`internal error: ...`); the server log has the full text and the exception type at error level. This is never the client's data: retrying with a different file does not help. For PDFs this is returned when every selected page failed (`page N: internal error: ...`); if only some pages failed the response is 200 with those pages absent (detectable through `page_number` gaps against pagesFrom/pagesTo) and one error line per page in the log.

QueueOverloaded.description: GPU inference queue is saturated. Retry per `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds the client should wait before retrying.

version.description: Product version of the running build, from the VERSION file at compile time. Independent of `info.version`, which is the version of THIS contract. Reads "unknown" only if the build was made without the version define.

activated.description: Whether activation succeeded and the new .lic is live.

detail.description: Human-readable outcome (mode resolved, or the failure reason).

LicenseStatus.description: Sanitised license snapshot — fields are limited to what an ops dashboard needs (countdown, quota, plan). No machine-identifying or cryptographic material.

mode.description: Active resolution outcome. 'none' covers uninitialised / unknown / Token-stub.

status.description: Whether requests would currently be accepted. 'expired' calls out the most common renewal trigger; other deny reasons (limit reached, fingerprint mismatch, counter tampered) collapse to 'none' and surface only in per-request 403 bodies.

used.description: Requests served against the active counter in the CURRENT 30-day window (resets every 30 days from the activation timestamp — see windowResetsAt).

limit.description: Configured request limit FOR THE 30-DAY WINDOW. -1 = no quota (a valid license is loaded with limits.requestLimit absent). 0 = no license at all. Positive integer = per-30-day budget.

windowResetsAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the current 30-day counter window expires and `used` will reset to 0. Empty when limit is 0 (no license) or -1 (unlimited — no window enforcement).

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the license itself expires. Empty when there's no .lic loaded.

product.description: Product line the .lic is bound to (e.g. 'OCR'). Empty when no .lic.

tariff.description: Plan tier from the .lic (e.g. 'BUSINESS'). Empty when no .lic.

Loc.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in pixels of the page rendering.

Block.description: One recognized text region (a word, a tagged field, or a table cell sub-block).

tag.description: Field/cell tag. `word` for untagged words, or a template-specific name (e.g. `lastName`, `birthday`, `snils_number`).

prob.description: Recognition confidence: per-character-normalized CTC forward probability of `text` given the crop.

det_prob.description: Detection confidence of the box itself (peak CRAFT region score; for stitched numbers, the weakest merged fragment). Orthogonal to `prob`: a high `prob` with a low `det_prob` means a confidently recognized but dubious region. Omitted when the box did not come from the CRAFT detector (mask-derived fields, handwriting).

Paragraph.description: A line-level grouping of words. Emitted only for `passport` and `snils` templates — `default`, `agreement`, and `regulation` omit this key.

cells.description: Row-major matrix: outer array = rows, inner array = cells of that row.

rotation.description: Clockwise angle, in degrees, the page as delivered (the displayed PDF page, i.e. with the document's /Rotate applied) must be turned so its text reads upright: 0 = already upright, 90 = a quarter turn clockwise, 180 = upside down, -90 = a quarter turn counter-clockwise. Present on every page read from the PDF text layer (0 included), which only ever reports 0, 90, 180 or -90. On OCR'd pages (images and rendered PDF pages) it is present when the page-geometry net analysed the page and was sure of its orientation: the server turned the page by this angle before recognition: the quarter turn (0 = analysed, already upright, 90, 180, -90) plus, when the server's skew straightening is enabled (`page_deskew` in provision_ocr.ini, on by default), the residual skew it also straightened, e.g. -7.43 (two decimals; a skew below `page_deskew_min_deg`, 4 degrees by default, is left alone and the value stays the quarter alone; by default the skew is the angle of the text lines found on the page and is applied only when they confirm the net within `page_deskew_text_agree_deg`, 5 degrees). Absent when the net is disabled, its weights are missing, the template opts out (`recognition.page_geometry: false`) or the net was not sure enough to act — absence is not 0, the page was then processed as delivered. Every `loc` in the page — page, blocks, paragraphs, tables, cells — stays in the delivered frame regardless of this value, and `width`/`height` are the delivered size. A turned page is read upright, so `blocks` come in reading order and table `cells` are the logical rows and columns: with rotation 90 a table row shows up as a vertical strip of cell `loc`s. On a straightened page every `loc` is the axis-aligned bounds, in the delivered frame, of the box as it lies on the tilted page, so word boxes grow with the tilt; the value is what the server actually applied, not the angle it measured.

figures.description: Reserved for future use; currently always emitted as [].

Document.description: Recognition result for one input. PDFs produce one entry whose `pages` array spans every page; image inputs produce one entry with a single `pages[0]`. PDF responses additionally carry pagesFrom/pagesTo/maxPages page-range metadata (absent for image inputs).

width.description: Width of the original input in pixels (or PDF points).

pagesFrom.description: PDF only: requested start of the page range (0-based, inclusive), echoed from the pagesFrom query param; 0 when the param was absent.

pagesTo.description: PDF only: end of the page range (exclusive). Echoes the pagesTo query param; when the param was absent, the effective bound (= total page count).

maxPages.description: PDF only: the document's REAL total page count, regardless of the requested range — lets clients paginate without a probe request.
